The selected firm will be required to perform the following tasks: e Perform and/or update load ratings in accordance with Federal and State requirements Review load ratings performed by others for conformance with Federal and State requirements and sound engineering principles. Perform and/or coordinate material testing, strain gauging, etc. Provide Design Services During Construction. Provide Task Order engineering services for project administration and bridge and structure design for the CTDOT.
